lesson.d: a time when a teacher helps you learn something
lesson.ex: Our science lesson is on Monday.

plant.d: a living thing that grows in soil and has leaves
plant.ex: My plant needs water every day.

live.d: to have your home in a place

place.d: a part of the world, like a town, a park or a room
place.ex: The park is my favorite place.

look.d: to use your eyes to see something
look.ex: Look at the bird in the tree!

wonder.d: to ask yourself a question in your head
wonder.ex: I wonder why the sky is blue.

desert.d: a dry place with very little rain

think.d: to use your mind to have an idea

grow.ex: My little sister grows so fast!

dry.ex: The ground is dry and cracked.

explore.d: to look around a new place to learn about it
explore.ex: We explore the woods with Dad.

inquiry.d: a question that you try to find the answer to
inquiry.ex: Our class did an inquiry about bugs.

activity.d: something you do, like a game or a job

happen.d: to take place; to come about
happen.ex: A fun thing happened at school today.

get.ex: I get a present on my birthday.

water.d: the clear liquid in rivers and rain that we drink
water.ex: I drink water when I am thirsty.

labeled.d: with a small paper tag on it that names it

put.d: to move something to a place
put.ex: Put your toys in the box.

sunny.ex: It is a sunny day at the beach.

predict.d: to say what you think will happen
predict.ex: I predict it will rain today.

observe.ex: We observe the fish in the tank.

watch.d: to look at something for some time
watch.ex: I watch the birds in the garden.

week.ex: We have art class once a week.

record.d: to write or draw something so you remember it
record.ex: Record the weather in your notebook.

data.d: facts that you collect to learn something
data.ex: We collect data about our pets.

draw.d: to make a picture with a pencil or crayon
draw.ex: I draw a flower for Mom.

classify.d: to put things into groups that are alike

kind.d: a group of things that are alike in some way
kind.ex: There are many kinds of apples.

wet.ex: My shoes are wet from the rain.

read.d: to look at words and understand them
read.ex: I read a book before bed.

learn.d: to get to know something new
learn.ex: I learn to ride a bike.

essential.ex: Water is essential for every living thing.

question.d: something you ask to find out an answer

different.ex: The two cats are different colors.

vocabulary.d: the words you know or learn
vocabulary.ex: We learn new vocabulary every week.

rain_forest.d: a hot, wet forest with lots of rain and very tall trees
rain_forest.ex: Monkeys and parrots live in the rain forest.

arctic.d: the very cold place around the North Pole
arctic.ex: Polar bears live in the Arctic.

part.ex: A wheel is a part of a bike.

help.d: to make something easier for someone
help.ex: I help Mom carry the bags.

store.d: to keep something to use later

thick.d: wide from one side to the other side
thick.ex: This tree has a thick trunk.

stem.d: the long part of a plant that holds up the leaves and flowers
stem.ex: The sunflower has a tall green stem.

spiny.ex: Do not touch the spiny cactus!

leaf.d: a flat green part of a plant
leaf.ex: A leaf fell on my head.

large.ex: An elephant is a large animal.

extra.ex: I have an extra pencil for you.

photo.d: a picture made with a camera
photo.ex: Dad took a photo of us.

shape.d: the form of something, like a circle or a square
shape.ex: A ball has a round shape.

cold.ex: It is cold outside, so wear a hat.

icy.ex: The road is icy, so walk slowly.

north_pole.d: the place at the very top of the Earth
north_pole.ex: The North Pole is covered with ice.

group.ex: We read in a small group.

close.ex: The cat sits close to the fire.

ground.d: the top of the land under your feet
ground.ex: The ball is on the ground.

keep.d: to make something stay the same way

safe.ex: The baby bird is safe in its nest.

wind.ex: The wind blows my kite high.

snow.d: soft white ice that falls from the sky when it is cold
snow.ex: We made a snowman with the snow.

melt.d: to change from ice into water when it gets warm
melt.ex: My ice cream melts in the sun.

flower.d: the colorful part of a plant
flower.ex: I picked a red flower for Grandma.

lab.d: a room where scientists do tests
lab.ex: We wear goggles in the lab.

freezer.d: a very cold box that keeps food frozen
freezer.ex: The ice is in the freezer.

day.d: the time from morning to night

root.d: the part of a plant that grows under the ground
root.ex: Roots drink water from the soil.

surface.d: the top or outside part of something
surface.ex: A leaf floats on the surface of the pond.

frozen.d: turned hard into ice because it is very cold
frozen.ex: The pond is frozen in winter.

soil.d: the top brown part of the ground where plants grow

talk.ex: I talk with my friend at lunch.

write.d: to put words on paper with a pencil or pen
write.ex: I write in my journal every day.

problem.d: something wrong that you need to fix
problem.ex: My bike has a problem: a flat tire.

solution.ex: The solution is to pump up the tire.

social_studies.d: a school subject about people, places and how we live together
social_studies.ex: In social studies we learn about maps.

link.ex: This story has a link to our science lesson.

science.d: learning about the world by watching and testing
science.ex: In science we look at bugs and plants.

own.d: belonging to you and nobody else

garden.d: a place where people grow flowers or vegetables
garden.ex: We grow tomatoes in our garden.

people.ex: Many people are at the beach.

like.d: would like: to want something in a polite way
like.ex: I would like some juice, please.

eat.d: to put food in your mouth and swallow it

remember.d: to keep something in your mind

use.d: to do something with a thing
use.ex: I use a spoon to eat soup.

word.d: a sound or group of letters that means something
word.ex: Baby can say three words now.

look_like.d: to seem the same as someone or something

math.d: learning about numbers, counting and shapes

fruit.d: the sweet part of a plant that you can eat, like an apple

sale.d: for sale: ready for people to buy
sale.ex: The apples are for sale at the market.

jasmine.ex: Jasmine wants to buy some fruit.

want.d: to wish to have or do something

buy.d: to get something by giving money
buy.ex: We buy bread at the bakery.

market.d: a place where people buy and sell food and other things
market.ex: We buy fresh fruit at the market.

coin.d: a small, round piece of metal money
coin.ex: I put a coin in my piggy bank.

count.d: to say numbers in order to find how many

apple.d: a round red or green fruit
apple.ex: I eat an apple at lunch.

lemon.d: a yellow fruit that tastes sour

lime.d: a small green fruit that tastes sour
lime.ex: A lime is green and sour.

know.d: to have something in your mind

quarter.d: an American coin that is worth 25 cents

worth.ex: This toy car is worth one dollar.

cent.d: a very small amount of money; 100 cents make one dollar

dime.d: a small American coin that is worth 10 cents
dime.ex: A dime is smaller than a penny.
